description: Fire Incident Responses is published by Bloomington Fire Department. The response table records fire-service incidents, responding units and event times. Its stated coverage is Bloomington, United States; calls for service. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. A records-system change in July 2023 altered some fields despite the effort to preserve continuity. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
